title: Multi-dimensional measurement model
concept: Five outcome categories interpreted with evidence and narrative
accessible_description: The practitioner's mission and capacity frame five separate outcome categories: contribution, relationships, learning, relevant reach and influence, and commercial outcomes. Evidence, time period, missing data, and bias support each category. A human reviews all categories with narrative context and chooses a decision, experiment, stop, or no change. The categories do not collapse into one influence score, and commercial outcomes do not outrank community value or learning.
